summary: Iteration 94 - Revenue Management Module Testing Complete. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Revenue Mgmt accessible from sidebar, 3 main tabs (Dashboard, Rate Calendar, Pricing Strategy) working. Dashboard shows 3 gradient KPI cards with YOY badges, Occupancy Heatmap with color-coded cells for 10 properties, YOY Property Tables. Rate Calendar shows monthly calendar with Prices/Occupancy/Pickup view toggles, today highlighted with purple badge, month navigation arrows, room type selector. Pricing Strategy has 4 sub-tabs (Rooms Setup, Day-of-Week, Monthly, Occupancy) - Rooms Setup shows table with Reference/Derived room types when specific property selected.

issues: When 'All Branches' is selected, Rooms Setup table shows empty (expected behavior - room types are property-specific). Consider adding a message like 'Select a specific property to view room setup'

tests: Revenue Mgmt accessible from sidebar (data-testid='revenue-btn')
3 main tabs: Dashboard, Rate Calendar, Pricing Strategy
3 gradient KPI cards: Last Month (March £1,298), Current Month (April £5,595), Next Month (May £178)
KPI cards show revenue, occupancy %, YOY badges
Occupancy Heatmap shows 10 properties with color-coded cells
Heatmap legend: 90%+ green, 70-89% light green, 50-69% amber, 25-49% orange, 1-24% red, 0% gray
YOY Property Tables show month rows with prev_rev, curr_occ, curr_adr, curr_rev, variance%
Monthly calendar view with April 2026
Month navigation arrows (prev/next)
View toggles: Prices, Occupancy, Pickup
Today (day 16) highlighted with purple badge 'Today'
Room Type selector dropdown
Performance metrics: Occupancy %, Expected by Today %, Target Occupancy
Calendar cells show recommended rate (£70) and PMS rate (£100 PMS)
4 sub-tabs: Rooms Setup, Day-of-Week, Monthly Adjustments, Occupancy Strategy
Rooms Setup table shows 6 room types for ALDGATE FLATS
Table columns: Name, Room in PMS, Rate in PMS, Rooms, Ref/Derived, Base Price, Derivation, Min Price, Max Price
First room marked as 'Reference', others as 'Derived'
Day-of-Week shows Mon-Sun with adjustment percentages
Monthly Adjustments shows Jan-Dec with adjustment percentages
Occupancy Strategy shows 5 pricing tiers with color indicators
GET /api/revenue/dashboard/{property_id} - Returns KPIs for last/current/next month with YOY
GET /api/revenue/dashboard/all - Returns aggregated KPIs for all properties
GET /api/revenue/heatmap - Returns occupancy data for all properties (default 30 days)
GET /api/revenue/heatmap?days=14 - Custom day range
GET /api/revenue/yoy-tables - Returns YOY revenue comparison per property per month
GET /api/revenue/rate-calendar/{property_id} - Returns daily rates, occupancy, recommended prices
GET /api/revenue/rate-calendar/{property_id}?year=2026&month=5 - Custom month
GET /api/revenue/rate-calendar/{property_id}?room_type=... - Filter by room type
GET /api/revenue/pricing-strategy/{property_id} - Returns rooms setup and pricing rules
PUT /api/revenue/pricing-strategy/{property_id} - Updates pricing strategy
All endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
